description.value: Bar Oso is a Spanish-influenced small plates restaurant in Whistler Village Square, offering pintxos, charcuterie boards, Ibérico ham, and a notable gin & tonic program. Part of the same acclaimed restaurant group as Araxi and Il Caminetto, it draws on Spanish regional cooking with dishes like gambas al ajillo, octopus, and Basque cheesecake. Cyclists looking for a sit-down dinner destination in the heart of Whistler will find a full, shareable menu suited to refuelling after a day on the trails.
